summary: Four-legged steel survey tower, about 50 ft, in Ozark County; the Central US Lookouts site lists it as removed and no source describes the site now.

facts.design: Four-legged steel tower, painted aluminum, with a small open cage at the top
facts.status_note: The Central US Lookouts site lists the lookout as removed. No source describes what remains at the site.

events.note: Coast and Geodetic Survey station description; calls it the Nottinghill lookout tower and gives its height as about 50 feet

notes_for_editor: Thin record: one page, which reproduces the 1953 Coast and Geodetic Survey station description and carries a Removed status label. Searches found no build date, no staffing history, no fire record and no post-removal description of the site. The height in the record (15.2 m) matches the survey's about 50 feet. The record's status gone agrees with the Removed label. Access is unknown and left out of facts. The Wikipedia article on the community was not used as a source.
